name: family-sites-bar
title: Family sites bar
description: A slim strip above the header that lists the sibling sites of a group, with the current one marked and a link to the parent.
docs: Pass group ({ label, href }, written as it is read: "Part of Northwind"), the sites ({ label, href }), current (an href or a label) and an optional trailing link, usually to the group home. The strip is one navigation landmark named "Our sites"; the current site gets aria-current, weight, an underline and the words "Current site" for a screen reader. Sibling links open in the same tab, and every label stays on one line: from lg up a list that is wider than the room it has scrolls sideways with fading edges instead of wrapping, and the group keeps its whole name. Below lg the sites move into a button that opens a panel under the strip: a disclosure, closed by Escape, a click elsewhere, Tab leaving it or choosing a link, with the current site marked in plain words and the trailing link as its last row. linkAs renders the links with your router's Link; labels translates the fixed words. The server renders everything but the button's open state and the fade of the list.
